description: This file defines the Snapshotter class used for capturing and managing page frame snapshots within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for starting, resetting, stopping, and capturing snapshots of browser frames, as well as handling frame hierarchy annotations.

classes.name: Snapshotter
classes.description: Manages capturing and processing page frame snapshots, including initialization, reset, and snapshot capture functionalities.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the snapshotter, initializes scripts if needed, and resets state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the snapshotter state by invoking reset on all frames.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Prepares the snapshotter for reuse by removing scripts and event listeners.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the snapshotter by setting up event listeners and injecting scripts into pages.

methods.name: _captureFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a specific frame.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures snapshots of all frames in a page and delegates the snapshot data.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Handles new page events to set up frame hierarchy annotation.

methods.name: _annotateFrameHierarchy
methods.description: Annotates frame hierarchy for snapshot purposes.
